entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: N-Not like I'm freakin' out or anything...[n]H-Haha, no way...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't there some kinda hole we can get[n]through...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: These bars're tougher than they look...
The metal bars feel cold to the touch...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What time is it now?[n]Ain't it still mornin'?
It's in tatters... I would like to avoid using[n]it at all costs...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Like, somewhere we could kick and bust[n]the wall down? Dammit... It's no use...
There are no cracks in sight...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those freakin' chains... At least we can[n]move now...
There's a somewhat dull sheen[n]to these shackles...
It seems this barrel is empty...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, should we hide in here and trick[n]the guards?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, are there even any guards[n]'round here...?
It's emitting a pungent, foul odor...[n]It seems like there's something[n]inside here...
